+++ b/src/crypto.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,143 @@
+import { ml_kem768_x25519 as kem } from "@noble/post-quantum/hybrid.js";
+
+export const SUITE = "X-Wing-ML-KEM-768-X25519/HKDF-SHA-256/AES-256-GCM";
+const encoder = new TextEncoder();
+const recipientContext = encoder.encode("daily-grind/recipient-key/v1");
+const random = (length) => crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(length));
+export const generateRecipient = () => kem.keygen();
+
+function metadata(envelope) {
+  return encoder.encode(
+    JSON.stringify({
+      version: envelope.version,
+      suite: envelope.suite,
+      id: envelope.id,
+      createdAt: envelope.createdAt,
+    }),
+  );
+}
+
+async function deriveKey(secret, salt, context) {
+  try {
+    const material = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
+      "raw",
+      secret,
+      "HKDF",
+      false,
+      ["deriveKey"],
+    );
+    return await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
+      { name: "HKDF", hash: "SHA-256", salt, info: context },
+      material,
+      { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
+      false,
+      ["encrypt", "decrypt"],
+    );
+  } finally {
+    secret.fill(0);
+  }
+}
+
+export async function encryptNote(publicKey, text) {
+  if (!text.trim() || text.length > 1000)
+    throw new Error("Invalid note length");
+  const envelope = {
+    version: 1,
+    suite: SUITE,
+    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    salt: random(32),
+    iv: random(12),
+  };
+  const { cipherText, sharedSecret } = kem.encapsulate(publicKey);
+  const context = metadata(envelope);
+  const key = await deriveKey(sharedSecret, envelope.salt, context);
+  const plaintext = encoder.encode(text);
+  try {
+    envelope.capsule = cipherText;
+    envelope.ciphertext = new Uint8Array(
+      await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
+        {
+          name: "AES-GCM",
+          iv: envelope.iv,
+          additionalData: context,
+          tagLength: 128,
+        },
+        key,
+        plaintext,
+      ),
+    );
+    return envelope;
+  } finally {
+    plaintext.fill(0);
+  }
+}
+
+export async function decryptNote(secretKey, envelope) {
+  if (
+    envelope.version !== 1 ||
+    envelope.suite !== SUITE ||
+    !(envelope.iv instanceof Uint8Array) ||
+    envelope.iv.length !== 12 ||
+    !(envelope.salt instanceof Uint8Array) ||
+    envelope.salt.length !== 32 ||
+    typeof envelope.id !== "string" ||
+    typeof envelope.createdAt !== "string"
+  ) {
+    throw new Error("Unsupported or invalid encrypted note");
+  }
+  const secret = kem.decapsulate(envelope.capsule, secretKey);
+  const context = metadata(envelope);
+  const key = await deriveKey(secret, envelope.salt, context);
+  const plaintext = new Uint8Array(
+    await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
+      {
+        name: "AES-GCM",
+        iv: envelope.iv,
+        additionalData: context,
+        tagLength: 128,
+      },
+      key,
+      envelope.ciphertext,
+    ),
+  );
+  try {
+    return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(plaintext);
+  } finally {
+    plaintext.fill(0);
+  }
+}
+
+// Store only an encrypted private key. IndexedDB can clone the non-extractable wrapping key.
+export async function protectRecipient(secretKey) {
+  const key = await crypto.subtle.generateKey(
+    { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
+    false,
+    ["encrypt", "decrypt"],
+  );
+  const iv = random(12);
+  try {
+    const ciphertext = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
+      { name: "AES-GCM", iv, additionalData: recipientContext },
+      key,
+      secretKey,
+    );
+    return { key, iv, ciphertext };
+  } finally {
+    secretKey.fill(0);
+  }
+}
+
+export async function recoverRecipient(protectedKey) {
+  return new Uint8Array(
+    await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
+      {
+        name: "AES-GCM",
+        iv: protectedKey.iv,
+        additionalData: recipientContext,
+      },
+      protectedKey.key,
+      protectedKey.ciphertext,
+    ),
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/notes.mjs b/src/notes.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7d8fb0a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/notes.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+import {
+  generateRecipient,
+  encryptNote,
+  decryptNote,
+  protectRecipient,
+  recoverRecipient,
+} from "./crypto.mjs";
+
+const form = document.querySelector("#notes-form");
+const fields = document.querySelector("#note-fields");
+const input = document.querySelector("#delivery-note");
+const status = document.querySelector("#note-status");
+const saved = document.querySelector("#saved-note");
+const reveal = document.querySelector("#reveal-note");
+const remove = document.querySelector("#delete-note");
+const preview = document.querySelector("#note-preview");
+const counter = document.querySelector("#note-count");
+const submit = document.querySelector("#save-note");
+let db;
+let busy = false;
+
+function database() {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const request = indexedDB.open("daily-grind-private-notes", 1);
+    request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore("notes");
+    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error("Storage is blocked"));
+  });
+}
+
+function storage(operation, value) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const transaction = db.transaction(
+      "notes",
+      operation === "get" ? "readonly" : "readwrite",
+    );
+    const store = transaction.objectStore("notes");
+    const request =
+      operation === "put"
+        ? store.put(value, "current")
+        : store[operation]("current");
+    transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(request.result);
+    transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
+    transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
+  });
+}
+
+function hidePreview() {
+  preview.textContent = "";
+  preview.hidden = true;
+  reveal.textContent = "Reveal note";
+  reveal.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
+}
+function announce(message, error = false) {
+  status.textContent = message;
+  status.classList.toggle("error", error);
+}
+function setBusy(value) {
+  busy = value;
+  fields.disabled = value;
+  reveal.disabled = value;
+  remove.disabled = value;
+  form.setAttribute("aria-busy", String(value));
+}
+
+input.addEventListener("input", () => {
+  counter.textContent = `${input.value.length} / 1,000`;
+  input.setCustomValidity("");
+});
+form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (busy || !db) return;
+  if (!input.value.trim()) {
+    input.setCustomValidity("Add a delivery note before saving.");
+    input.reportValidity();
+    return;
+  }
+  setBusy(true);
+  hidePreview();
+  announce("Encrypting your note on this device…");
+  let recipient;
+  try {
+    recipient = generateRecipient();
+    const envelope = await encryptNote(recipient.publicKey, input.value);
+    const protectedKey = await protectRecipient(recipient.secretKey);
+    await storage("put", { envelope, protectedKey });
+    input.value = "";
+    counter.textContent = "0 / 1,000";
+    saved.hidden = false;
+    submit.innerHTML =
+      'Replace encrypted note <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>';
+    announce(
+      "Note encrypted and saved on this browser. It has not been sent to a courier.",
+    );
+  } catch {
+    announce(
+      "Your note could not be saved. Check that browser storage is available and try again.",
+      true,
+    );
+  } finally {
+    recipient?.secretKey.fill(0);
+    setBusy(false);
+  }
+});
+
+reveal.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+  if (!preview.hidden) {
+    hidePreview();
+    return;
+  }
+  if (busy) return;
+  setBusy(true);
+  let secret;
+  try {
+    const record = await storage("get");
+    if (!record) throw new Error("No saved note");
+    secret = await recoverRecipient(record.protectedKey);
+    preview.textContent = await decryptNote(secret, record.envelope);
+    preview.hidden = false;
+    reveal.textContent = "Hide note";
+    reveal.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
+    announce("Note decrypted locally. Hide it when you’re finished.");
+  } catch {
+    hidePreview();
+    announce(
+      "This note could not be authenticated or decrypted. Its contents have not been displayed.",
+      true,
+    );
+  } finally {
+    secret?.fill(0);
+    setBusy(false);
+  }
+});
+remove.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+  if (busy) return;
+  setBusy(true);
+  hidePreview();
+  try {
+    await storage("delete");
+    saved.hidden = true;
+    submit.innerHTML = 'Encrypt & save note <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>';
+    announce("Saved note and its encryption key deleted from this browser.");
+  } catch {
+    announce("The note could not be deleted. Please try again.", true);
+  } finally {
+    setBusy(false);
+  }
+});
+document.querySelector("#clear-note").addEventListener("click", () => {
+  input.value = "";
+  input.setCustomValidity("");
+  counter.textContent = "0 / 1,000";
+  hidePreview();
+  input.focus();
+});
+document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
+  if (document.hidden) hidePreview();
+});
+window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => {
+  hidePreview();
+  input.value = "";
+  counter.textContent = "0 / 1,000";
+});
+
+async function initialize() {
+  try {
+    if (!globalThis.isSecureContext || !crypto.subtle || !globalThis.indexedDB)
+      throw new Error("Unsupported browser");
+    db = await database();
+    db.onversionchange = () => {
+      db.close();
+      fields.disabled = true;
+      announce("Reload this page to reconnect to secure storage.", true);
+    };
+    const existing = await storage("get");
+    saved.hidden = !existing;
+    if (existing)
+      submit.innerHTML =
+        'Replace encrypted note <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>';
+    fields.disabled = false;
+    announce(
+      existing
+        ? "Your encrypted note is saved on this browser."
+        : "Ready to encrypt. Your note stays on this browser.",
+    );
+  } catch {
+    fields.disabled = true;
+    announce(
+      "Secure notes are unavailable. Use HTTPS and allow browser storage. Nothing has been saved.",
+      true,
+    );
+  }
+}
+initialize();

+import test from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import {
+  generateRecipient,
+  encryptNote,
+  decryptNote,
+  protectRecipient,
+  recoverRecipient,
+} from "../src/crypto.mjs";
+
+const note = "Side door, please. 门口 ☕\nGive a gentle knock.";
+
+test("hybrid KEM envelope decrypts Unicode notes and stores no plaintext", async () => {
+  const { publicKey, secretKey } = generateRecipient();
+  const envelope = await encryptNote(publicKey, note);
+  assert.equal(await decryptNote(secretKey, envelope), note);
+  assert.equal(envelope.iv.length, 12);
+  assert.equal(envelope.capsule.length, 1120);
+  assert.equal(
+    envelope.ciphertext.length,
+    new TextEncoder().encode(note).length + 16,
+  );
+  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(envelope).includes("Side door"));
+});
+
+test("each save creates a fresh encapsulation, salt, nonce, and record ID", async () => {
+  const { publicKey } = generateRecipient();
+  const first = await encryptNote(publicKey, note);
+  const second = await encryptNote(publicKey, note);
+  for (const field of ["capsule", "salt", "iv", "id", "ciphertext"])
+    assert.notDeepEqual(first[field], second[field]);
+});
+
+test("ciphertext, capsule, nonce, salt and bound metadata tampering are rejected", async () => {
+  const { publicKey, secretKey } = generateRecipient();
+  const original = await encryptNote(publicKey, note);
+  for (const field of ["ciphertext", "capsule", "iv", "salt"]) {
+    const changed = structuredClone(original);
+    changed[field][0] ^= 1;
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(secretKey, changed), undefined, field);
+  }
+  for (const field of ["id", "createdAt", "suite", "version"]) {
+    const changed = structuredClone(original);
+    changed[field] = field === "version" ? 2 : "tampered";
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(secretKey, changed), undefined, field);
+  }
+});
+
+test("another recipient cannot decrypt the note", async () => {
+  const recipient = generateRecipient();
+  const other = generateRecipient();
+  await assert.rejects(
+    decryptNote(other.secretKey, await encryptNote(recipient.publicKey, note)),
+  );
+});
+
+test("recipient key is wrapped, non-extractable, cloneable and recoverable", async () => {
+  const { secretKey, publicKey } = generateRecipient();
+  const envelope = await encryptNote(publicKey, note);
+  const protectedKey = await protectRecipient(secretKey);
+  assert.ok(secretKey.every((value) => value === 0));
+  assert.equal(protectedKey.key.extractable, false);
+  await assert.rejects(crypto.subtle.exportKey("raw", protectedKey.key));
+  const recovered = await recoverRecipient(structuredClone(protectedKey));
+  assert.equal(await decryptNote(recovered, structuredClone(envelope)), note);
+  recovered.fill(0);
+});
+
+test("tampered wrapped private key is rejected", async () => {
+  const protectedKey = await protectRecipient(generateRecipient().secretKey);
+  const ciphertext = new Uint8Array(protectedKey.ciphertext);
+  ciphertext[0] ^= 1;
+  await assert.rejects(recoverRecipient({ ...protectedKey, ciphertext }));
+});
+
+test("empty and oversized notes are rejected", async () => {
+  const { publicKey } = generateRecipient();
+  await assert.rejects(encryptNote(publicKey, "   "));
+  await assert.rejects(encryptNote(publicKey, "a".repeat(1001)));
+});

+# The Daily Grind
+
+Static coffee homepage with browser-encrypted delivery notes. Run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm build` to produce `dist/`. The checked-in `assets/app.js` also supports the existing static-root hosting setup. Serve over HTTPS (or localhost) for Web Crypto. No server application is included.
+
+## Delivery note flow
+
+The default is a **local demo**. Recipient private keys exist only in memory for this page session; refreshing or closing the page makes earlier demo notes unrecoverable. Only an authenticated encrypted envelope is saved in localStorage. Preview decrypts locally. Download exports ciphertext; delete removes the local saved envelope. Nothing is submitted to a delivery service.
+
+For a real recipient, open **Delivery team key settings** and import a trusted public key JSON bundle with this shape:
+
+```json
+{
+  "version": 1,
+  "hybrid": "<base64 X-Wing public key>",
+  "classical": "<base64 X25519 public key>",
+  "quantum": "<base64 ML-KEM-768 public key>"
+}
+```
+
+Generate these keys on the recipient's trusted system, retaining private keys there. `generateRecipient()` in `src/crypto.js` demonstrates the compatible key bundle format; it must not be used to distribute private keys to senders. All three public keys are required. Imported bundles are validated, fingerprinted with SHA-256, and require explicit fingerprint confirmation before encryption. Verify that fingerprint with the intended recipient through a trusted channel. A fingerprint does not independently authenticate an untrusted key.
+
+Recipients can use `decryptNote(envelope, { publicKeys, secretKeys })` with their matching private keys. For production delivery integration, provision authenticated recipient public keys and send the exported envelope to the authorized delivery backend. This checkout has neither an authenticated key directory nor a delivery API. Browser encryption cannot protect against malicious page scripts or an already compromised device.
+
+## Envelope protocol, version 1
+
+- Hybrid: the noble library's X-Wing KEM (X25519 + ML-KEM-768).
+- Classical: fresh ephemeral X25519 agreement for each encryption.
+- Post-quantum: ML-KEM-768 encapsulation for each encryption.
+- HKDF-SHA-256 derives a nonextractable AES-256-GCM key from the shared secret, a random 32-byte salt, and protocol/mode/recipient context.
+- Each encryption uses a fresh 12-byte IV and a 128-bit authentication tag. The JSON-serialized header is authenticated as additional data, including version, mode, recipient fingerprint, exchange material, salt, IV, and timestamp. Recipients must preserve its property order for the version 1 JSON encoding.
+- Temporary byte arrays for shared secrets and plaintext are cleared after use where possible. JavaScript garbage collection does not guarantee erasure of strings or internal library copies. Private keys and plaintext are never intentionally persisted or transmitted.
+
+The build performs round trips for all modes and checks fresh ciphertext, wrong-recipient rejection, tampered ciphertext, tampered metadata, invalid key bundles, and invalid note lengths. It then bundles browser dependencies locally; cryptographic code is not loaded from a CDN. No browser or development server is needed for the build.
+
+Cryptographic implementation: [noble-post-quantum documentation](https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-post-quantum). Photography: Unsplash. Fonts: Google Fonts.

+import { build } from 'esbuild';
+import { mkdir, copyFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { generateRecipient, validatePublicKeys, encryptNote, decryptNote, modes } from '../src/crypto.js';
+
+// Build-time cryptographic checks; no server or browser is started.
+const recipient = generateRecipient();
+validatePublicKeys(recipient.publicKeys);
+for (const mode of modes) {
+  const note = 'Side door, please. ☕ No doorbell.';
+  const sealed = await encryptNote(note, mode, recipient.publicKeys);
+  assert.equal(await decryptNote(sealed, recipient), note);
+  assert.notEqual((await encryptNote(note, mode, recipient.publicKeys)).ciphertext, sealed.ciphertext);
+  const tampered = structuredClone(sealed);
+  tampered.ciphertext = (tampered.ciphertext[0] === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A') + tampered.ciphertext.slice(1);
+  await assert.rejects(() => decryptNote(tampered, recipient));
+  const metadata = structuredClone(sealed);
+  metadata.header.createdAt = 'altered';
+  await assert.rejects(() => decryptNote(metadata, recipient));
+  await assert.rejects(() => decryptNote(sealed, generateRecipient()));
+}
+await assert.rejects(() => encryptNote('', 'hybrid', recipient.publicKeys));
+await assert.rejects(() => encryptNote('x'.repeat(501), 'hybrid', recipient.publicKeys));
+assert.throws(() => validatePublicKeys({ version: 1, hybrid: 'AA==' }));
+Object.values(recipient.secretKeys).forEach(key => key.fill(0));
+await build({ entryPoints: ['src/app.js'], bundle: true, minify: true, format: 'esm', target: 'es2022', outfile: 'assets/app.js', legalComments: 'eof' });
+await mkdir('dist/assets', { recursive: true });
+for (const path of ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'assets/app.js']) await copyFile(path, `dist/${path}`);
+console.log('Build passed: three encryption modes, round trips, randomized ciphertext, wrong-key rejection, and ciphertext/metadata tamper detection.');

+import { generateRecipient, validatePublicKeys, fingerprint, encryptNote, decryptNote, modes } from './crypto.js';
+
+const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
+const storageKey = 'daily-grind.encrypted-delivery-note.v1';
+const names = { hybrid: 'Hybrid · X-Wing', classical: 'Classical · X25519', quantum: 'Post-quantum · ML-KEM-768' };
+const descriptions = {
+  hybrid: 'The best of both worlds. X-Wing combines X25519 and ML-KEM-768, with AES-256-GCM to keep your note private.',
+  classical: 'X25519 key agreement establishes a shared secret. AES-256-GCM encrypts your note and checks its integrity. This option does not include post-quantum protection.',
+  quantum: 'ML-KEM-768 encapsulates a shared secret with post-quantum protection. AES-256-GCM encrypts your note and checks its integrity.',
+};
+let recipient;
+let saved;
+let recipientFingerprint;
+let busy = false;
+let confirmed = true;
+function status(message, error = false) {
+  $('status').textContent = message;
+  $('status').classList.toggle('error', error);
+}
+function wipeRecipient() {
+  if (recipient?.secretKeys) Object.values(recipient.secretKeys).forEach(key => key.fill(0));
+}
+async function showRecipient() {
+  const id = await fingerprint(recipient.publicKeys);
+  recipientFingerprint = id;
+  $('fingerprint').textContent = `SHA-256: ${id.match(/.{1,4}/g).join(' ')}`;
+  $('recipient-status').textContent = recipient.secretKeys ? 'Recipient: local demo (this session only)' : 'Recipient: imported delivery team keys';
+  $('save-context').textContent = recipient.secretKeys ? '● Local demo · stays on this device' : '● Delivery team keys · export after saving';
+  $('confirm-key-wrap').hidden = !!recipient.secretKeys;
+  $('confirm-key').checked = !!recipient.secretKeys;
+  confirmed = !!recipient.secretKeys;
+  $('decrypted-note').hidden = true;
+  $('decrypted-note').textContent = '';
+  $('preview-note').textContent = 'Preview note';
+  renderSaved();
+}
+function renderSaved() {
+  $('saved-note').hidden = !saved;
+  if (!saved) return;
+  $('saved-mode').textContent = names[saved.header.mode];
+  $('saved-detail').textContent = 'Only ciphertext is saved on this device. Download the encrypted file to share it with the recipient. Nothing has been sent to a delivery service.';
+  const canPreview = recipient?.secretKeys && saved.header.recipient === recipientFingerprint;
+  $('preview-note').disabled = !canPreview;
+  $('preview-note').title = canPreview ? '' : 'The original recipient private key is required to open this note.';
+  if (recipient?.secretKeys && !canPreview) $('saved-detail').textContent = 'This encrypted note was saved for a different recipient or an earlier demo session. Its original private key is required to open it. You can download, replace, or delete it.';
+}
+const keyConfirmation = document.createElement('label');
+keyConfirmation.id = 'confirm-key-wrap';
+keyConfirmation.hidden = true;
+const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
+checkbox.type = 'checkbox'; checkbox.id = 'confirm-key';
+keyConfirmation.append(checkbox, document.createTextNode(' I verified this fingerprint with my delivery team.'));
+$('fingerprint').after(keyConfirmation);
+checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => { confirmed = checkbox.checked; });
+
+$('delivery-note').addEventListener('input', () => {
+  $('character-count').textContent = `${$('delivery-note').value.length} / 500`;
+});
+document.querySelectorAll('[name="protection"]').forEach(radio => radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
+  $('protection-description').textContent = descriptions[radio.value];
+}));
+$('notes-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (busy) return;
+  if (!recipient) return status('Secure encryption is unavailable. Use a browser with Web Crypto over HTTPS or localhost.', true);
+  if (!confirmed) return status('Confirm the imported key fingerprint in delivery team key settings before saving.', true);
+  const note = $('delivery-note').value;
+  if (!note.trim()) { status('Add a delivery note before saving.', true); $('delivery-note').focus(); return; }
+  busy = true;
+  $('save-button').disabled = true;
+  $('recipient-file').disabled = true;
+  $('demo-recipient').disabled = true;
+  status('Encrypting your note on this device…');
+  try {
+    const mode = document.querySelector('[name="protection"]:checked').value;
+    const envelope = await encryptNote(note, mode, recipient.publicKeys);
+    // The plaintext and private keys never go into persistent browser storage.
+    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(envelope));
+    saved = envelope;
+    $('delivery-note').value = '';
+    $('character-count').textContent = '0 / 500';
+    $('decrypted-note').hidden = true;
+    $('decrypted-note').textContent = '';
+    renderSaved();
+    status(recipient.secretKeys ? 'Encrypted and saved locally. This demo note can only be opened during this page session.' : 'Encrypted for your delivery team and saved locally. Download the file to share it.');
+  } catch {
+    status('Your note could not be saved. Check that browser storage is available and your recipient keys are valid, then try again.', true);
+  } finally {
+    busy = false;
+    $('save-button').disabled = false;
+    $('recipient-file').disabled = false;
+    $('demo-recipient').disabled = false;
+  }
+});
+$('preview-note').addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (!saved || !recipient?.secretKeys) return;

+    $('decrypted-note').textContent = '';
+    $('decrypted-note').hidden = true;
+    $('preview-note').textContent = 'Preview note';

+  }

+    $('decrypted-note').textContent = await decryptNote(saved, recipient);
+    $('decrypted-note').hidden = false;
+    $('preview-note').textContent = 'Hide note';
+    status('Decrypted locally for this preview. Hide it when you’re finished.');
+  } catch {
+    status('This note cannot be opened in this session. Its original private key is required, or its authentication check failed.', true);
+  }
+});
+$('download-note').addEventListener('click', () => {
+  if (!saved) return;
+  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(saved, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }));
+  const link = document.createElement('a');
+  link.href = url; link.download = 'daily-grind-encrypted-note.json'; link.click();
+  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
+  status('Encrypted file downloaded. Share it only with the intended recipient.');
+});
+$('delete-note').addEventListener('click', () => {
+  try {
+    localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
+    saved = undefined;
+    $('decrypted-note').textContent = '';
+    $('decrypted-note').hidden = true;
+    $('preview-note').textContent = 'Preview note';
+    renderSaved(); status('Saved note deleted from this device.');
+  } catch { status('Browser storage is unavailable. The saved note could not be deleted.', true); }
+});
+$('recipient-file').addEventListener('change', async (event) => {
+  const file = event.target.files[0];
+  if (!file || busy) return;
+  busy = true;
+  $('recipient-file').disabled = true;
+  $('demo-recipient').disabled = true;
+  $('save-button').disabled = true;
+  try {
+    if (file.size > 15000) throw new Error('Public key files must be smaller than 15 KB.');
+    const publicKeys = validatePublicKeys(JSON.parse(await file.text()));
+    wipeRecipient();
+    recipient = { publicKeys };
+    await showRecipient();
+    status('Public keys imported. Verify the SHA-256 fingerprint with your delivery team before saving.');
+  } catch (error) { status(`Could not import keys. ${error.message}`, true); }
+  finally {
+    busy = false;
+    event.target.value = '';
+    $('recipient-file').disabled = false;
+    $('demo-recipient').disabled = false;
+    $('save-button').disabled = false;
+  }
+});
+$('demo-recipient').addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (busy) return;
+  busy = true;
+  $('save-button').disabled = true;
+  $('recipient-file').disabled = true;
+  $('demo-recipient').disabled = true;
+  try {
+    const next = generateRecipient();
+    wipeRecipient(); recipient = next;
+    await showRecipient(); status('New local demo keys created. Existing notes still require their original private keys.');
+  } catch { status('Could not initialize local encryption.', true); }
+  finally {
+    busy = false;
+    $('save-button').disabled = false;
+    $('recipient-file').disabled = false;
+    $('demo-recipient').disabled = false;
+  }
+});
+window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
+  $('delivery-note').value = '';
+  $('decrypted-note').textContent = '';
+  $('decrypted-note').hidden = true;
+});
+async function initialize() {
+  if (!globalThis.crypto?.subtle) throw new Error('Web Crypto unavailable');
+  recipient = generateRecipient();
+  await showRecipient();
+  try {
+    const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey));
+    if (stored && stored.header?.version === 1 && modes.includes(stored.header?.mode) && typeof stored.ciphertext === 'string') {
+      saved = stored; renderSaved();
+    }
+  } catch { status('Browser storage is unavailable or contains an unreadable note. New notes can be saved when storage is available.', true); }
+}
+initialize().catch(() => {
+  $('save-button').disabled = true;
+  status('Secure encryption is unavailable. Open this page over HTTPS in a browser with Web Crypto support.', true);
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+import { XWing } from '@noble/post-quantum/hybrid.js';
+import { ml_kem768 } from '@noble/post-quantum/ml-kem.js';
+import { x25519 } from '@noble/curves/ed25519.js';
+
+const encoder = new TextEncoder();
+const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true });
+export const modes = ['hybrid', 'classical', 'quantum'];
+export const toBase64 = (bytes) => btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes));
+export function fromBase64(value) {
+  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 10000 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(value)) throw new Error('Invalid key encoding.');
+  return Uint8Array.from(atob(value), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
+}
+const algorithms = { hybrid: XWing, quantum: ml_kem768 };
+const random = (length) => crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(length));
+
+export function generateRecipient() {
+  const hybrid = XWing.keygen();
+  const quantum = ml_kem768.keygen();
+  const classical = x25519.keygen();
+  return {
+    publicKeys: { version: 1, hybrid: toBase64(hybrid.publicKey), classical: toBase64(classical.publicKey), quantum: toBase64(quantum.publicKey) },
+    secretKeys: { hybrid: hybrid.secretKey, classical: classical.secretKey, quantum: quantum.secretKey },
+  };
+}
+
+export function validatePublicKeys(input) {
+  if (!input || input.version !== 1) throw new Error('Expected a version 1 public key bundle.');
+  const expected = { hybrid: XWing.lengths.publicKey, classical: 32, quantum: ml_kem768.lengths.publicKey };
+  const clean = { version: 1 };
+  for (const mode of modes) {
+    const bytes = fromBase64(input[mode]);
+    if (bytes.length !== expected[mode]) throw new Error(`Invalid ${mode} public key length.`);
+    // Check actual encapsulation / agreement as well as lengths before accepting a recipient.
+    if (mode === 'classical') {
+      const pair = x25519.keygen();
+      try { x25519.getSharedSecret(pair.secretKey, bytes).fill(0); } finally { pair.secretKey.fill(0); }
+    } else algorithms[mode].encapsulate(bytes).sharedSecret.fill(0);
+    clean[mode] = toBase64(bytes);
+  }
+  return clean;
+}
+export async function fingerprint(keys) {
+  const canonical = JSON.stringify({ version: 1, hybrid: keys.hybrid, classical: keys.classical, quantum: keys.quantum });
+  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', encoder.encode(canonical))), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
+}
+async function deriveKey(sharedSecret, header, usage) {
+  const material = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', sharedSecret, 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
+  return crypto.subtle.deriveKey({ name: 'HKDF', hash: 'SHA-256', salt: fromBase64(header.salt), info: encoder.encode(`daily-grind/delivery-note/v1/${header.mode}/${header.recipient}`) }, material, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, [usage]);
+}
+export async function encryptNote(note, mode, publicKeys) {
+  if (!modes.includes(mode)) throw new Error('Unknown protection mode.');
+  if (typeof note !== 'string' || !note.trim() || note.length > 500) throw new Error('Please enter a note of 1–500 characters.');
+  let sharedSecret, exchange;
+  if (mode === 'classical') {
+    const ephemeral = x25519.keygen();
+    try {
+      sharedSecret = x25519.getSharedSecret(ephemeral.secretKey, fromBase64(publicKeys.classical));
+      exchange = toBase64(ephemeral.publicKey);
+    } finally { ephemeral.secretKey.fill(0); }
+  } else {
+    const result = algorithms[mode].encapsulate(fromBase64(publicKeys[mode]));
+    sharedSecret = result.sharedSecret;
+    exchange = toBase64(result.cipherText);
+  }
+  try {
+    const header = { version: 1, mode, recipient: await fingerprint(publicKeys), exchange, salt: toBase64(random(32)), iv: toBase64(random(12)), createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };
+    const key = await deriveKey(sharedSecret, header, 'encrypt');
+    const plaintext = encoder.encode(note);
+    try {
+      const ciphertext = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: fromBase64(header.iv), additionalData: encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(header)), tagLength: 128 }, key, plaintext);
+      return { header, ciphertext: toBase64(new Uint8Array(ciphertext)) };
+    } finally { plaintext.fill(0); }
+  } finally { sharedSecret.fill(0); }
+}
+export async function decryptNote(envelope, recipient) {
+  const header = envelope?.header;
+  if (!header || header.version !== 1 || !modes.includes(header.mode) || header.recipient !== await fingerprint(recipient.publicKeys)) throw new Error('This note belongs to a different recipient or session.');
+  const exchange = fromBase64(header.exchange);
+  let sharedSecret;
+  if (header.mode === 'classical') sharedSecret = x25519.getSharedSecret(recipient.secretKeys.classical, exchange);
+  else sharedSecret = algorithms[header.mode].decapsulate(exchange, recipient.secretKeys[header.mode]);
+  try {
+    const key = await deriveKey(sharedSecret, header, 'decrypt');
+    const plaintext = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: fromBase64(header.iv), additionalData: encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(header)), tagLength: 128 }, key, fromBase64(envelope.ciphertext)));
+    try { return decoder.decode(plaintext); } finally { plaintext.fill(0); }
+  } finally { sharedSecret.fill(0); }
+}

--- a/index.html
+++ b/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="en">
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8">
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
+    <title>Load data</title>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <button type="button" id="load">Load data</button>
+    <output id="result" aria-live="polite"></output>
+    <script>
+      const result = document.getElementById('result');
+
+      document.getElementById('load').addEventListener('click', () => {
+        result.textContent = 'Loading…';
+
+        // Start the critical request first, with a high-priority hint.
+        fetch('/api/data', { priority: 'high' })
+          .then(response => {
+            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Data request failed (${response.status})`);
+            return response.json();
+          })
+          .then(data => { result.textContent = JSON.stringify(data); })
+          .catch(error => { result.textContent = error.message; });
+
+        // Run independently so analytics never delays displaying the data.
+        fetch('/api/analytics', {
+          method: 'POST',
+          priority: 'low',
+          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+          body: JSON.stringify({ click: 1 })
+        }).catch(error => console.error('Analytics request failed:', error));
+      });
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+# Script performance diagnostics
+
+The page loads `script-performance.js` with `defer`. It observes buffered Long
+Animation Frames and aggregates script execution time across observer callbacks.
+No data is sent to a server and the visitor-facing page is unchanged.
+
+In Chrome or Edge 123+, use the site normally, then run this in the DevTools console:
+
+```js
+scriptPerformance.report(); // Scripts with at least 100 ms of accumulated time
+scriptPerformance.report(0); // All observed scripts, ranked by accumulated time
+scriptPerformance.snapshot(); // Get raw summaries without logging
+```
+
+A report also runs when the page becomes hidden. Enable Preserve log in DevTools
+to retain console output across navigation. Measurements accumulate until reload.
+The report includes source URL, invocation count, total duration, longest
+invocation, and forced style/layout duration, all times in milliseconds. Start
+investigating scripts with the highest total duration or longest invocation.
+
+This measures script work attributed to frames longer than 50 ms, not download
+time or all JavaScript execution. Attribution can be missing (including
+cross-origin work); forced layout time is part of script duration, not extra
+time to add to it. No results do not prove that the page is fast. This initial
+page has no other scripts, so an empty report is expected unless new scripts or
+other attributable work are introduced.
+
+Unsupported browsers skip observation; `scriptPerformance.supported` reports
+availability. Summaries retain at most 200 distinct sources to bound memory;
+reports disclose omitted invocations if that limit is reached. There are no
+dependencies, polling timers, or network requests beyond loading the monitor.

+## Local network and loopback access
+
+The Astro middleware explicitly allows the application's own origin to use
+`local-network` and `loopback-network` through the `Permissions-Policy` response
+header. This permits the browser to request user approval; it does not grant
+permission automatically. If the app is embedded cross-origin, its parent must
+also delegate these permissions in its policy and iframe `allow` attribute.
+
+Serve the deployed application over HTTPS. Initiate connections from an explicit
+user action when permission has not already been granted. For HTTP endpoints,
+set `targetAddressSpace: 'local'` (LAN) or `targetAddressSpace: 'loopback'`
+(`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, or `[::1]`) in the client-side `fetch` options. The target
+service must allow the application's origin through standard CORS headers to
+read responses. Requests must run in the user's browser: server-side requests
+connect to the hosting server's network instead.
+
+If checking permission before connecting, query `local-network` or
+`loopback-network` inside a `try/catch`, and fall back to a user-initiated request
+when the browser does not recognize the permission. Avoid querying the legacy
+`local-network-access` permission, which can crash older Chromium renderers.
+Handle connection failures and direct users who denied permission to their
+browser's site settings to re-enable access.

+Daily Grind account UI integration
+
+This checkout is a static site with no identity service or database. The UI is
+available at / and /account/. The existing storefront is at /home.html.
+
+GET /api/account/passkeys must use the signed-in session and return this complete,
+unpaginated JSON snapshot, with Cache-Control: no-store:
+{
+  "user": {
+    "id": "base64url-WebAuthn-user-handle",
+    "name": "customer@example.com",
+    "displayName": "Customer Name"
+  },
+  "rpId": "your-domain.example",
+  "csrfToken": "session-bound-CSRF-token",
+  "credentials": [{
+    "id": "base64url-credential-id",
+    "name": "My laptop",
+    "provider": "iCloud Keychain",
+    "deviceType": "laptop",
+    "currentDevice": true,
+    "registeredAt": 1790812800000,
+    "lastUsedAt": 1793145600000
+  }]
+}
+
+registeredAt/lastUsedAt are epoch milliseconds; lastUsedAt may be null.
+The currentDevice flag is optional and must be derived from the authenticated
+session, not guessed from the browser user agent. Device types: laptop/phone/key.
+Derive provider display metadata from AAGUID at registration; unknown AAGUIDs
+should use a generic name. AAGUID must never drive authorization decisions.
+
+PUT /api/account/passkeys/:id accepts {"name":"New nickname"}.
+DELETE /api/account/passkeys/:id removes that credential.
+Both require the session and X-CSRF-Token header, check credential ownership,
+and return the same complete snapshot AFTER committing the mutation.
+Use a transaction to return a consistent complete credential list. Validate
+trimmed nicknames (1–60 characters) server-side. Return 401/403 for unauthenticated
+or forbidden requests. Authorize every operation from the session, never user IDs
+supplied by a client. Require a fresh authenticated session for sensitive changes.
+POST /logout accepts the session-bound csrfToken form field and ends the session.
+
+The user handle and credential IDs must be the original WebAuthn base64url IDs,
+not internal database row IDs. Production must use HTTPS with the correct RP ID.
+The client feature-detects signalAllAcceptedCredentials, calling it after initial
+load and successful deletion using ONLY a complete validated server response.
+It never calls signalCurrentUserDetails for a credential nickname change.
+Unsupported or failed sync leaves account changes intact and instructs the user
+to remove old entries from their password manager manually.
+
+For this static preview only, a missing API (404 or successful HTML fallback)
+enables the visibly labeled demo. Demo changes persist in localStorage under
+ daily-grind-passkey-demo-v1. Demo credentials NEVER reach authenticator APIs.
+401/403, network errors and other server errors never enable the demo.
+Before production, provide all endpoints above and disable the demo fallback in
+account.js if demo accounts should not be offered when the API is missing.
+
+No dev server, preview server, browser session or server entrypoint is required
+to edit this site. There is no build step and no additional runtime dependency.

+const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
+const list = $('#passkey-list');
+const dialog = $('#key-dialog');
+const form = $('#key-form');
+const storageKey = 'daily-grind-passkey-demo-v1';
+const endpoint = '/api/account/passkeys';
+let snapshot;
+let demo = false;
+let action;
+let selectedId;
+let busy = false;
+let toastTimer;
+let loadSequence = 0;
+
+// Demo IDs are labels only. They must never reach WebAuthn's Signal API.
+const demoSnapshot = () => ({
+  user: { id: 'demo-user', name: 'alex@example.com', displayName: 'Alex Morgan' },
+  credentials: [
+    { id: 'demo-macbook', name: 'MacBook Pro', provider: 'iCloud Keychain', deviceType: 'laptop', currentDevice: true, registeredAt: Date.UTC(2026, 8, 12), lastUsedAt: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 28) },
+    { id: 'demo-iphone', name: 'iPhone 15', provider: 'iCloud Keychain', deviceType: 'phone', registeredAt: Date.UTC(2026, 8, 12), lastUsedAt: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 26) },
+    { id: 'demo-security-key', name: 'YubiKey', provider: 'Security key', deviceType: 'key', registeredAt: Date.UTC(2026, 6, 24), lastUsedAt: Date.UTC(2026, 8, 18) }
+  ]
+});
+
+function validateSnapshot(data, live = true) {
+  if (!data || !data.user || typeof data.user.id !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(data.credentials)) throw new Error('We received an incomplete passkey list. Please try again.');
+  const ids = new Set();
+  for (const key of data.credentials) {
+    if (typeof key.id !== 'string' || !key.id || ids.has(key.id) || typeof key.name !== 'string' || !key.name.trim() || !Number.isFinite(key.registeredAt) || (key.lastUsedAt != null && !Number.isFinite(key.lastUsedAt))) throw new Error('We received an incomplete passkey list. Please try again.');
+    ids.add(key.id);
+  }
+  if (live) {
+    const base64url = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/;
+    const validId = (id) => base64url.test(id) && id.length % 4 !== 1;
+    if (!validId(data.user.id) || !data.credentials.every(key => validId(key.id)) || typeof data.rpId !== 'string' || !(location.hostname === data.rpId || location.hostname.endsWith(`.${data.rpId}`)) || typeof data.csrfToken !== 'string' || !data.csrfToken) throw new Error('Account security information is unavailable. Please try again.');
+  }
+  return data;
+}
+
+function svg(name, className) {
+  const element = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
+  element.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
+  if (className) element.setAttribute('class', className);
+  const use = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'use');
+  use.setAttribute('href', `#${name}`);
+  element.append(use);
+  return element;
+}
+function node(tag, className, text) {
+  const element = document.createElement(tag);
+  if (className) element.className = className;
+  if (text != null) element.textContent = text;
+  return element;
+}
+const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
+function date(timestamp) { return dateFormatter.format(new Date(timestamp)); }
+function render() {
+  list.replaceChildren();
+  list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
+  $('#key-count').textContent = snapshot.credentials.length;
+  $('#member-name').textContent = snapshot.user.displayName || 'Coffee lover';
+  $('#member-caption').textContent = demo ? 'Welcome to your daily ritual.' : 'Your Daily Grind account';
+  $('#demo-notice').hidden = !demo;
+  if (!snapshot.credentials.length) {
+    const empty = node('div', 'empty');
+    empty.append(node('strong', '', 'No passkeys registered'), node('span', '', 'There are no passkeys on this account. Use your other sign-in method to return to your daily ritual.'));
+    list.append(empty);
+  }
+  for (const key of snapshot.credentials) {
+    const row = node('article', 'passkey-row');
+    const device = node('span', 'device-icon');
+    device.append(svg(['phone', 'laptop', 'key'].includes(key.deviceType) ? key.deviceType : 'key'));
+    const info = node('div', 'key-info');
+    const title = node('div', 'key-title');
+    title.append(node('h4', '', key.name));
+    if (key.currentDevice) title.append(node('span', 'device-badge', 'This device'));
+    info.append(title, node('p', 'provider', key.provider || 'Unknown passkey provider'));
+    const dates = node('p', 'dates');
+    dates.append(document.createTextNode(`Added ${date(key.registeredAt)}`), node('span', '', '·'), document.createTextNode(key.lastUsedAt ? `Last used ${date(key.lastUsedAt)}` : 'Not used yet'));
+    info.append(dates);
+    const actions = node('div', 'row-actions');
+    for (const kind of ['rename', 'delete']) {
+      const button = node('button', kind);
+      button.type = 'button';
+      button.title = `${kind === 'rename' ? 'Rename' : 'Delete'} passkey`;
+      button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${kind === 'rename' ? 'Rename' : 'Delete'} ${key.name}`);
+      button.dataset.id = key.id;
+      button.dataset.action = kind;
+      button.append(svg(kind === 'rename' ? 'edit' : 'trash'));
+      actions.append(button);
+    }
+    row.append(device, info, actions);
+    list.append(row);
+  }
+}
+
+function notify(message, error = false) {
+  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
+  $('#toast span').textContent = message;
+  $('#toast').style.background = error ? '#8d4334' : '';
+  $('#toast').hidden = false;
+  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { $('#toast').hidden = true; }, 6500);
+}
+function syncMessage(message) { $('#sync-message').textContent = message; }
+async function syncAcceptedCredentials() {
+  if (demo) {
+    syncMessage('Demo mode: your real passkeys and browser authenticator are never changed.');
+    return;
+  }
+  // Only use the complete, unfiltered, authenticated server snapshot.
+  if (!window.isSecureContext || !window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalAllAcceptedCredentials) {
+    syncMessage('Your browser doesn’t support automatic passkey updates. After deleting a key here, remove its saved entry in your password manager too.');
+    return;
+  }
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({
+      rpId: snapshot.rpId,
+      userId: snapshot.user.id,
+      allAcceptedCredentialIds: snapshot.credentials.map(key => key.id)
+    });
+    syncMessage('Your browser has been notified of your current passkeys. Fingerprint and face data are never shared with us.');
+  } catch {
+    syncMessage('Your account is up to date, but your browser couldn’t update its saved passkeys. Remove any deleted entries in your password manager.');
+  }
+}
+
+async function readResponse(response) {
+  if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) throw new Error('Please sign in again to manage your passkeys.');
+  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('We couldn’t save your changes. Please try again.');
+  return validateSnapshot(await response.json());
+}
+function readDemo() {
+  try {
+    const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
+    return saved ? validateSnapshot(JSON.parse(saved), false) : demoSnapshot();
+  } catch { return demoSnapshot(); }
+}
+async function load() {
+  const sequence = ++loadSequence;
+  list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
+  try {
+    const response = await fetch(endpoint, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
+    if (sequence !== loadSequence) return;
+    const isStaticFallback = response.status === 404 || (response.ok && response.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('text/html'));
+    if (isStaticFallback) {
+      demo = true;
+      snapshot = readDemo();
+    } else {
+      demo = false;
+      snapshot = await readResponse(response);
+    }
+    if (sequence !== loadSequence) return;
+    render();
+    void syncAcceptedCredentials();
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (sequence !== loadSequence) return;
+    snapshot = undefined;
+    list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
+    const empty = node('div', 'empty');
+    empty.append(node('strong', '', 'Your passkeys are unavailable'), node('p', '', error.message || 'Please check your connection and try again.'));
+    const retry = node('button', 'secondary retry', 'Try again');
+    retry.addEventListener('click', load);
+    empty.append(retry);
+    list.replaceChildren(empty);
+    $('#key-count').textContent = '—';
+    syncMessage('No changes have been made to your account or authenticator.');
+  }
+}
+
+list.addEventListener('click', event => {
+  const button = event.target.closest('button[data-action]');
+  if (!button || busy || !snapshot) return;
+  const key = snapshot.credentials.find(key => key.id === button.dataset.id);
+  if (!key) return;
+  action = button.dataset.action;
+  selectedId = key.id;
+  const deleting = action === 'delete';
+  form.reset();
+  $('#form-error').textContent = '';
+  $('#rename-field').hidden = deleting;
+  $('#key-name').required = !deleting;
+  $('#key-name').value = key.name;
+  $('#last-key-warning').hidden = !(deleting && snapshot.credentials.length === 1);
+  $('#dialog-title').textContent = deleting ? 'Delete this passkey?' : 'Give it a familiar name.';
+  $('#dialog-description').textContent = deleting ? `“${key.name}” will no longer be able to sign in to your account. This can’t be undone.` : 'Choose a name that makes this passkey easy to recognize. This label is only used in your Daily Grind account.';
+  $('#confirm-dialog').textContent = deleting ? 'Delete passkey' : 'Save name';
+  $('#confirm-dialog').classList.toggle('danger', deleting);
+  dialog.showModal();
+  (deleting ? $('#cancel-dialog') : $('#key-name')).focus();
+  if (!deleting) $('#key-name').select();
+});
+$('#cancel-dialog').addEventListener('click', () => { if (!busy) dialog.close(); });
+dialog.addEventListener('cancel', event => { if (busy) event.preventDefault(); });
+form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (busy || !snapshot) return;
+  const newName = $('#key-name').value.trim();
+  if (action === 'rename' && !newName) {
+    $('#form-error').textContent = 'Enter a name for this passkey.';
+    $('#key-name').focus();
+    return;
+  }
+  const deleting = action === 'delete';
+  const oldKey = snapshot.credentials.find(key => key.id === selectedId);
+  if (!oldKey) return;
+  busy = true;
+  $('#form-error').textContent = '';
+  $('#confirm-dialog').disabled = true;
+  $('#cancel-dialog').disabled = true;
+  $('#key-name').disabled = true;
+  $('#confirm-dialog').textContent = deleting ? 'Deleting…' : 'Saving…';
+  try {
+    if (demo) {
+      const next = { ...snapshot, credentials: deleting ? snapshot.credentials.filter(key => key.id !== selectedId) : snapshot.credentials.map(key => key.id === selectedId ? { ...key, name: newName } : key) };
+      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(next));
+      snapshot = next;
+    } else {
+      const response = await fetch(`${endpoint}/${encodeURIComponent(selectedId)}`, {
+        method: deleting ? 'DELETE' : 'PUT', credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store',
+        headers: { Accept: 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': snapshot.csrfToken },
+        ...(deleting ? {} : { body: JSON.stringify({ name: newName }) }),
+        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000)
+      });
+      snapshot = await readResponse(response);
+    }
+    dialog.close();
+    render();
+    // Nicknames only change the account label, never authenticator user details.
+    if (deleting) void syncAcceptedCredentials();
+    notify(deleting ? `“${oldKey.name}” was deleted${demo ? ' from the demo' : ''}.` : 'Passkey name updated.');
+    const target = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('button[data-action]')).find(button => button.dataset.id === selectedId) || list.querySelector('button') || $('#passkeys-title');
+    if (!target.hasAttribute('tabindex') && target.tagName !== 'BUTTON') target.tabIndex = -1;
+    target.focus();
+  } catch (error) {
+    $('#form-error').textContent = demo ? 'Your browser couldn’t save this change. Allow local storage and try again.' : error.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
+  } finally {
+    busy = false;
+    $('#confirm-dialog').disabled = false;
+    $('#cancel-dialog').disabled = false;
+    $('#key-name').disabled = false;
+    $('#confirm-dialog').textContent = deleting ? 'Delete passkey' : 'Save name';
+  }
+});
+$('#reset-demo').addEventListener('click', () => {
+  if (!demo || busy) return;
+  try { localStorage.removeItem(storageKey); } catch { /* The fresh in-memory demo still works. */ }
+  snapshot = demoSnapshot();
+  render();
+  notify('Demo passkeys restored.');
+});
+const sections = {
+  overview: ['Your daily ritual, at a glance.', 'Welcome to your Daily Grind account. Keep your sign-in options up to date in Login & security.'],
+  details: ['Personal details', 'Your account details are provided by your signed-in profile.'],
+  preferences: ['A little more your way.', 'Your sign-in preferences and registered passkeys are available in Login & security.']
+};
+function showSection(section) {
+  const security = section === 'security';
+  $('#security-section').hidden = !security;
+  $('#other-section').hidden = security;
+  document.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(button => {
+    const selected = button.dataset.section === section;
+    button.classList.toggle('selected', selected);
+    if (selected) button.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
+    else button.removeAttribute('aria-current');
+  });
+  if (!security) {
+    $('#other-title').textContent = sections[section][0];
+    $('#other-copy').textContent = section === 'details' && snapshot ? `${snapshot.user.displayName || 'Coffee lover'} · ${snapshot.user.name || ''}${demo ? ' — Demo profile. Your real personal details are unchanged.' : ''}` : sections[section][1];
+  }
+}
+document.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => showSection(button.dataset.section)));
+$('#back-security').addEventListener('click', () => showSection('security'));
+$('#signout').addEventListener('click', () => {
+  if (demo) notify('This is a demo account. No real account is signed in.');
+  else {
+    const logout = document.createElement('form');
+    logout.method = 'POST'; logout.action = '/logout';
+    const token = document.createElement('input');
+    token.type = 'hidden'; token.name = 'csrfToken'; token.value = snapshot?.csrfToken || '';
+    logout.append(token); document.body.append(logout); logout.submit();
+  }
+});
+$('#privacy-button').addEventListener('click', () => notify('Your biometric data stays on your device. Daily Grind only stores public passkey credentials.'));
+window.addEventListener('storage', event => {
+  if (demo && event.key === storageKey && !busy) {
+    dialog.close(); snapshot = readDemo(); render();
+    notify('Demo passkeys updated in another tab.');
+  }
+});
+void load();

+<!DOCTYPE html>
+<html lang="en">
+
+<head>
+  <meta charset="UTF-8">
+  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
+  <title>The Daily Grind | Artisanal Coffee</title>
+  <style>
+    :root {
+      --primary: #4e342e;
+      --secondary: #d7ccc8;
+      --accent: #ffab40;
+      --text: #3e2723;
+      --light: #fafafa;
+    }
+
+    * {
+      box-sizing: border-box;
+      margin: 0;
+      padding: 0;
+    }
+
+    body {
+      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
+      line-height: 1.6;
+      color: var(--text);
+      background-color: var(--light);
+    }
+
+    /* Navigation */
+    nav {
+      background: var(--primary);
+      color: white;
+      padding: 1rem 5%;
+      display: flex;
+      justify-content: space-between;
+      align-items: center;
+      position: sticky;
+      top: 0;
+      z-index: 1000;
+    }
+
+    .logo {
+      font-size: 1.5rem;
+      font-weight: bold;
+      letter-spacing: 1px;
+    }
+
+    nav ul {
+      display: flex;
+      list-style: none;
+    }
+
+    nav ul li {
+      margin-left: 20px;
+    }
+
+    nav a {
+      color: white;
+      text-decoration: none;
+      font-size: 0.9rem;
+      transition: color 0.3s;
+    }
+
+    nav a:hover {
+      color: var(--accent);
+    }
+
+    .logout-link {
+      border: 1px solid var(--accent);
+      padding: 5px 12px;
+      border-radius: 4px;
+    }
+
+    /* Hero Section */
+    .hero {
+      height: 60vh;
+      background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)),
+        url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1495474472287-4d71bcdd2085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1350&q=80');
+      background-size: cover;
+      background-position: center;
+      display: flex;
+      flex-direction: column;
+      justify-content: center;
+      align-items: center;
+      color: white;
+      text-align: center;
+      padding: 0 20px;
+    }
+
+    .hero h1 {
+      font-size: 3rem;
+      margin-bottom: 1rem;
+    }
+
+    /* Content Sections */
+    .container {
+      max-width: 1100px;
+      margin: 40px auto;
+      padding: 0 20px;
+    }
+
+    .grid {
+      display: grid;
+      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
+      gap: 20px;
+      margin-top: 20px;
+    }
+
+    .card {
+      background: white;
+      padding: 20px;
+      border-radius: 8px;
+      box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
+      text-align: center;
+    }
+
+    .card h3 {
+      margin-bottom: 10px;
+      color: var(--primary);
+    }
+
+    .btn {
+      display: inline-block;
+      background: var(--primary);
+      color: white;
+      padding: 10px 20px;
+      text-decoration: none;
+      border-radius: 5px;
+      margin-top: 15px;
+      transition: background 0.3s;
+    }
+
+    .btn:hover {
+      background: #3e2723;
+    }
+
+    footer {
+      background: var(--secondary);
+      text-align: center;
+      padding: 40px 20px;
+      margin-top: 40px;
+    }
+
+    .footer-links {
+      margin-bottom: 20px;
+    }
+
+    .footer-links a {
+      margin: 0 10px;
+      color: var(--text);
+      text-decoration: none;
+      font-size: 0.85rem;
+    }
+  </style>
+</head>
+
+<body>
+
+  <nav>
+    <div class="logo">THE DAILY GRIND</div>
+    <ul>
+      <li><a href="/menu">Menu</a></li>
+      <li><a href="/locations">Locations</a></li>
+      <li><a href="/rewards">Rewards</a></li>
+      <li><a href="/account/">My Account</a></li>
+      <li><a href="/logout" class="logout-link">Logout</a></li>
+    </ul>
+  </nav>
+
+  <header class="hero">
+    <h1>Wake Up Your Senses</h1>
+    <p>Ethically sourced, locally roasted, delivered to your cup.</p>
+    <a href="/order-online" class="btn">Order Now</a>
+  </header>
+
+  <main class="container">
+    <section id="menu">
+      <h2 style="text-align: center;">Seasonal Favorites</h2>
+      <div class="grid">
+        <div class="card">
+          <h3>Maple Oat Latte</h3>
+          <p>Creamy oat milk with a hint of Vermont maple syrup.</p>
+          <a href="/menu/seasonal" class="btn">View Details</a>
+        </div>
+        <div class="card">
+          <h3>Dark Roast Espresso</h3>
+          <p>Bold, smokey, and perfect for a morning boost.</p>
+          <a href="/menu/espresso" class="btn">View Details</a>
+        </div>
+        <div class="card">
+          <h3>Cold Brew</h3>
+          <p>Steeped for 18 hours for maximum smoothness.</p>
+          <a href="/menu/cold-brew" class="btn">View Details</a>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+    </section>
+  </main>
+
+  <footer id="locations">
+    <p id="rewards">Your daily dose of good. Visit us for your next cup.</p>
+    <p id="story">Ethically sourced, locally roasted, delivered to your cup.</p>
+    <div class="footer-links">
+      <a href="/about">Our Story</a> |
+      <a href="/careers">Join the Team</a> |
+      <a href="/contact">Contact Us</a> |
+      <a href="/privacy-policy">Privacy</a>
+    </div>
+    <p>© 2026 The Daily Grind Coffee Co. All rights reserved.</p>
+  </footer>
+
+</body>
+
+</html>

+# The Daily Grind
+
+A customer account experience on the Daily Grind homepage, with native WebAuthn passkeys and server-side verification using [SimpleWebAuthn](https://simplewebauthn.dev/docs/packages/server).
+
+## Build and run
+
+Requires Node.js 22.13+ (Node 24 recommended) and pnpm.
+
+```sh
+pnpm install
+pnpm run build
+pnpm start
+```
+
+`build` bundles only the browser module; it does not start a server. The generated `assets/account.js` is included so the homepage can be served immediately. `server.js` serves the homepage and its account API on `PORT` (default `11222`). An unrelated static file server can display the page, but cannot handle account operations.
+
+## Deployment
+
+Set `NODE_ENV=production`, `PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://your-domain.example`, and optionally `DATA_DIR=/persistent/path` before starting the service. `PUBLIC_ORIGIN` must be the exact public origin, including any nonstandard port. Its hostname is the WebAuthn relying party ID. The production service requires HTTPS and fails at startup if the public origin is missing or insecure. In development the origin follows the request host, with same-host HTTPS requests supported behind a local reverse proxy. Local browser access must use `localhost` or HTTPS for WebAuthn.
+
+SQLite stores account identifiers, public credential keys, signature counters, transport hints, passkey metadata, and server-side sessions in `DATA_DIR/accounts.sqlite` (default `./data`). Use a persistent volume, restrict filesystem access, and back it up. No private keys or biometric data reach this service. The in-process request limiter is intended for a single application instance; add edge rate limiting for a public deployment, especially when running multiple instances. Production hosting must route every `/api` request to this service.
+
+## Account behavior
+
+- Registration collects a display name and email identifier, then commits the account only after passkey verification. Email ownership is not verified; email is an identifier, not an account recovery mechanism.
+- Sign-in supports discoverable passkeys through an explicit button and conditional email-field autofill where available. A phone or external security key can be used through the browser prompt.
+- Signed-in customers can add, rename, and remove saved passkeys, with creation and last-used dates. Removing the final passkey is blocked to avoid lockout. Removing a passkey revokes other signed-in sessions.
+- Profile edits, adding or renaming a passkey, and passkey removal require a new, user-verified assertion tied to the signed-in account. Server grants last 60 seconds, apply to one specific action, and are consumed once.
+- Challenges are session-bound, single-use, and expire after five minutes. Session cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure on HTTPS, and rotate on registration and sign-in. Sessions expire after seven days; signing out deletes the server session.
+- Password-manager Signal APIs are feature-detected. The app synchronizes accepted credentials when opening security settings and after removal, and account names after profile updates. Individual passkey nicknames do not change password-manager account names.
+- Unsupported browsers get guidance and disabled creation controls; cancellation and network failures produce recoverable messages. No password or email-based account recovery is implemented: customers should add a backup passkey on another provider/device.
+
+Provider names and small provider icons are a trimmed snapshot of the [passkey-authenticator-aaguids registry](https://github.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids). Unknown or omitted icons use a generic key; AAGUID metadata is used only as a display hint. Browser serialization and capability fallbacks use `webauthn-polyfills`.
+
+## Validation
+
+The frontend bundle was built without starting a development/preview server or importing the server entrypoint. Browser and real-authenticator verification are intentionally not part of this implementation run.
